label: Dust storm

alert.text: Dust storm: opacity rising. Return to the habitat.

notes: A global dust storm that keeps getting worse (#126): optical depth rises from dust.tau.clear_season 0.45 to dust.tau.gale_global_storm_2018 8.0 (Curiosity, Gale crater 2018, not Jezero) in public/data/hazards.json. In between it follows clear + (peak - clear) x (t / ramp)^2, slow at first and faster at every step (SIM). Ramp duration 90 s is dust.event.ramp_duration (SIM). The sky blend uses clear_day and dust_storm from atmosphere_presets.json. When it starts, and how fast this ramp runs, comes from the mission the crew's objective defines (src/sim/missions.js, #265): T+480 s and this 90 s ramp in the full EVA; in the first mission T+75 s at the earliest, once the crew has been at the sortie stop 20 s and is outside the 25 m end area, with the ramp compressed to 30 s (SIM).
